sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000030-P1, was presented by PFIZER (the Supplier) to Silver Oak Medical Group 030 on November 6, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 1.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 260 Pneumococcal doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
